adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the calendar update is executed via `new EventManager({ ...user, credentials: [...credentials] })` where `user`/`credentials` come from `ctx.user` (the caller) (`getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)`), but the constructed `evt.organizer` and `evt.destinationCalendar` are derived from the booking’s organizer/booking user (`booking.userId`, `booking.userPrimaryEmail`, `booking.destinationCalendar` / `booking.user.destinationCalendar`). This mismatch is visible in the diff and can cause `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` to run without the organizer’s calendar credentials when the caller isn’t the organizer. The handler also `include`s `booking.user.credentials` but never uses them, reinforcing the likely mix-up introduced here.
